notes: USD figures are a separate, independently-set tour-operator price list (not simply the KSH tour-operator rate converted) - both quoted verbatim.
USD payments only accepted via cash or online banking to the KSH account, converted at the bank's prevailing rate - no direct USD account.

childPolicy.raw: 0-5yrs: free. 6-12yrs: 50% of room rate (regardless of sharing with parents or not). 12+: full adult rate.

policies.payment: Full payment due prior to arrival
policies.cancellation: Cancelled within 5 days of arrival: full amount forfeited
policies.provisionalBookingHold: Released automatically 2 weeks after initial request, subject to demand
policies.accessibilityNote: Rooms on 1st/2nd floors, stairs only - advise in advance of mobility issues.
